mandatory_findings.finding: BaseException after Popen could escape the active-child path without bounded cleanup or explicit unresolved process evidence; unknown_operations was populated only for TimeoutExpired.
mandatory_findings.consequence: A started separate-session preparer could continue while a stopped launcher recorded an empty unknown_operations list.
mandatory_findings.required_change: Retain launch uncertainty before Popen, durable intent/start records, and bounded exceptional cleanup or explicit unresolved child evidence; keep filesystem publication pending until report/index reconciliation.

disposition: Rejected launcher and request preserved; never executed. Installation plans/source/archive bindings were not rejected.
